race.comment: OBUCCI (8) did not let down as expected last time out over 1200m, and she may be better over the shorter trips for now. A wide gate is no help, but the blinkers are off for the first time, and she deserves another chance. IN LOVE (7) has looked sharp at the trials, and she usually comes to hand quickly. A good draw has her right in this with a solid each-way chance. BOYD (1) was claimed late after hitting the front here 2 weeks ago, finishing fourth, and less than a length from the winner. He carries 3kg less this time thanks to a claim, and will be hard to beat. BABAYKA (5) is a tough veteran resuming from a spell, and is a top 4 hope. OVER YOUNDER (4) has raced his way into form, and with the aid of a 3kg claim from a good draw, he can figure in the finish.
